title: Retain explicit durable lifecycle witnesses and operation-specific state transitions
evidence: Full source and tests show independent immutable witnesses, cause/claim ordering, exact predecessor/successor revisions, nonreplayable dispatch custody and ordinary/provider-specific durable successors.

Ordinary stop abandonment enters FinalizingHistory with source/activity/transcript updates; provider abandonment consumes compaction with its independent receipt and returns Idle. Collapsing these cases would lose authenticated recovery guarantees.
retirement currently returns Option although every successful branch is Some; a concrete return is a small optional cleanup, not grounds for dropping ownership/retirement validation.
proposal: Retain the domain state machines, witnesses, checked counters, exact collision predicates and corruption/fault tests. Simplify construction/plumbing via SL-001 through SL-006. No substantial established-crate replacement was identified at these lifecycle boundaries; generic state-machine or serialization packages do not replace the persistent authority rules.
required_contract_changes: Removing retained guarantees would require Operator-owned lifecycle/persistence authority changes; not recommended.
